attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DNS resolver for the shared lan network (10.50.50.0/24), answering authoritatively for inventory.internal with node2's lan address and forwarding all other queries to public upstreams; configured node2 and node3 to resolve through node1. Implemented entirely via an Ansible playbook run from the designated control_node (node4), targeting node1 via raw VyOS configure-mode commands and node2/node3 via nmcli (through ansible.builtin.raw, since RHEL7's python2 was incompatible with modern ansible-core modules). Verified functionally, then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart/recovery protocol on all 4 nodes.
